task: Independent public ALE isolate-screening and multi-omics source audit
early_feature_rule: Last actual recorded OD at or before18h; no interpolation. Normalize by recorded0h OD for the second fixed proxy. No exponential growth-rate claim.
tie_break: Lexicographic isolate ID; endpoint titer is used only for retrospective evaluation, never to select growth-proxy winners.
identity_rule: Only explicit Chassis_{Sz,F,Mz}-{1,2,3}-{S,M,L} isolate IDs; underscore and hyphen encoding equivalent. Population mixtures and parental controls retained separately, never assigned as an isolate replicate.
support: Three product-specific designs, three separately evolved populations per design and three selected isolates per population. Isolates are clustered within population; these are not27 independent ALE lineages.
endpoint_OD_rule: Preserve the original ODmax field even when it differs from maximum observed trajectory OD; matching value times are diagnostics, not inferred product-assay times.
omics_rule: Use explicit Sample Name to MS Assay Name mapping within MetaboLights only. Across-omics replicate numbers and selected isolate IDs do not establish same culture identity. Keep E_Cassis_F metadata typo unresolved.
model_rule: No predictor fitting, crossvalidation, active selection benefit, FBA solving, biological wet work or new blinded validation. Spearman descriptive only, no significance inference.
scope_limits: Descriptive retrospective screening of published selected isolates, not a new prospective selection experiment or independent blind model evaluation.
OD trajectories are manual growth assays for the source appendix screening; this does not provide full continuous online bioreactor logs or verified sensor/assay arrival clocks.
Endpoint product collection time is not recorded in the source screen table. Do not infer productivity, arbitrary-time concentration accuracy or use matching OD to invent collection times.
Only nine evolution population groups across three product-specific genetic designs; within-population isolates are correlated and three designs are too few for broad cross-design generalization.
Parental glycine-supplemented and evolved unsupplemented comparisons can include medium changes; selected omics representatives are not established to be the same27 screened isolates.
Article methods report loss-of-production isolates whose genotypes were not verified to exclude contamination. Keep them as released records without assigning a mutation-based cause.
Chromatographic AUC and processed transcript/protein abundances are not concentration or intracellular flux. Archived SBML and published simulated fluxes do not constitute a new flux estimate.
Original concentration3563/error288/gain16 parameter counts and original8/11 plus3extra complete-paper counts stay unchanged; no publication superiority claim.
